create_app constructs repository, InstanceManager, SnapshotManager, ParameterGroupOrchestrator, audit/coverage/DR/maintenance/scaling/pool helpers and exposes instance/snapshot/PITR/parameter/maintenance HTTP routes with tenant headers and readiness/pool health—hub wiring, not a thin facade over one module.

≈476 substantive LOC hub with create/modify/stop/start/reboot/promote/failover; couples StorageEvaluator, DeletionGuard, ReplicaManager, FailoverCoordinator/Orchestrator/Heartbeat, VIPManager, ReplicationEngine/Coordinator, RecoveryCheckpointEngine, EventOutbox/Notification, ParameterGroupManager, state machine, KMS, scaling. Promote path registers slots, verifies LSN catchup, switches endpoints; failover acquires lease, persists failover_leases, runs VIP/orchestrator steps—cross-subsystem invariants with intentional starter traps.

Worker process_outbox_events loads pending outbox, EventDispatcher matching, EventNotificationService delivery, EventSubscriptionEngine routing, AuditMetricsEngine, FailoverLeaseHeartbeat—coupled event plane with D24 always-SENT trap retained.

PITR synthesize_restore_plan validates window, selects base snapshot, filters WAL segments, WALCollector continuity, CoverageAnalyzer coverage, WALPlaybackSimulator replay—multi-module recovery plan, not a constant stub.

Orchestrator validates via ParameterCatalog, merges family defaults, classifies dynamic vs pending-static through ParameterGroupManager—catalog apply_type metadata is consumed by classification logic rather than ornamental tables alone.
Lease acquire/validate, health-probe vs pool-saturation discrimination via ConnectionPoolMonitor, VIP migration via VIPManager—HA fencing surface with D17–D20 leaf traps still observable.

Persistent schema for db_instances, parameter groups/definitions, wal_archives, snapshots, event_outbox, failover_leases and related tables—runtime state model backing repository/SQL paths, not docs-only padding.
Multi-service topology: postgres:16 + rds-api (rdsd) + rds-worker with shared state/out volumes and healthgated DB dependency—credible production-like operator deployment.

role_output.MAJOR_MODULES: Entrypoints: rdsd (API), rds-worker (outbox/lease loop), rdsctl (operator CLI). Core hubs: app (FastAPI routes), cli, worker, instance_manager (lifecycle/promote/failover orchestration), repository+database+migrations (Postgres persistence), parameter_group_orchestrator+parameter_group+parameter_catalog (dynamic vs pending-reboot), pitr_engine+wal_collector+wal_playback_simulator+coverage_analyzer (PITR plan), failover_coordinator+failover_orchestrator+failover_lease_heartbeat+vip_manager (Multi-AZ fencing), replica_manager+replication_engine+replication_coordinator (promotion LSN topology), event_outbox+event_dispatcher+event_notification_service+event_subscription_engine (transactional notifications), recovery_checkpoint_engine+checkpoint_manager+state_machine, snapshot_manager, authorization+audit_metrics+readiness+disaster_recovery_evaluator+maintenance_scheduler, storage_evaluator+deletion_guard+kms_encryption_manager+instance_scaling_policy+connection_pool_monitor+cluster_manager, config/types/errors/digest/time_utils, fixture_generator (seed path only).
role_output.PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing InstanceManager status gates without StorageEvaluator/DeletionGuard leaves shrink/delete defects; promote without ReplicaManager lag/LS plus ReplicationCoordinator readiness still fails F2P; failover lease SQL without FailoverCoordinator fencing/VIP flush leaves D17–D20; PITR window partial fix without WAL continuity/coverage/playback desyncs restore plans; parameter apply without catalog apply_type classification leaves pending-reboot wrong; worker dispatcher delivery without FAILED audit/retry (D24) keeps outbox always SENT; readiness that ignores probes/outbox backlog stays READY while health endpoints look green; checkpoint helpers ignored on some transitions break restart continuity even if status updates succeed.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% (~850 LOC) of operator-reachable core would collapse production behavior: cut instance_manager (~476) alone removes lifecycle/promote/failover orchestration; cut parameter_group_orchestrator+catalog+parameter_group (~460) removes validated apply-mode semantics; cut pitr_engine+wal_*+coverage (~200) removes restore planning; cut failover_*+vip+heartbeat (~150) removes Multi-AZ fencing; cut worker+outbox/dispatcher/notification/subscription (~340) removes transactional event plane. Any such cluster removal leaves a CRUD/API shell without HA, PITR, parameter fencing, or outbox correctness—not a still-working toy at the stated RDS control-plane scope.
